To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the structural relaxation of the Co/Cu(111) system can be lifted by perimetic decoration with Fe, which is a prerequisite for the quantitative analysis of spin polarization and magnetic properties of nano structures.
the spin polarization and magnetic properties of individual nano structures vary strongly on the nm scale and are influenced by the surrounding.

spin-polarized tunneling spectroscopy can be used to determine the spin polarization of individual magnetic nano structures with high spatial resolution, and that structural relaxations and magnetic anisotropic effects at the border of nano structures have to be taken into account to understand the magnetic properties of individual nano structures.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the influence of structural relaxation on the spin polarization and magnetic properties of individual nano structures.
the investigation of the impact of structural relaxation of individual nano structures on spin-polarization and magnetization reversal.
the impact of structural relaxation of individual nano structures on the spin polarization and magnetism.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the magnetic anisotropies of the nano structures are not only influenced by the magnetic anisotropic energy of the bulk, but also by the spin-dependent electronic structure and the structural relaxation.
the structural relaxation of a magnetic nano structure has a strong influence on spin polarization and magnetic reversal of the nano structure.
the spin polarization and magnetic properties of nano structures depend on the structural properties, which can be modified by decoration with another material, e.g. Fe.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the structural relaxation of the magnetic nano structure is responsible for its magnetic properties and the spin polarization of the magnetic material.
the spin-polarized electronic properties of nano structures are strongly affected by structural relaxation and that the magnetic properties are strongly affected by the spin polarization.
the magnetic properties of individual nano structures can be quantified by low temperature spin-polarity scanning tunneling microscopy.
The main takeaway from our work is that
structural relaxation at the edge of nano structures has a profound influence on the spin polarization of the tunneling current and on the magnetic properties of individual nano structures.
structural relaxation at the border of a magnetic nano structure can be a source of magnetic anisotropies and can affect the spin polarization of the tunneling electrons.
spin-polarized STM and STS are powerful tools for the characterization of the magnetic properties of nano structures.
